text: The Arterial Blood Gas confirms respiratory acidosis and hypoxemia, indicating significant ventilation-perfusion mismatch. speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray showing fine reticular granulation with a ground-glass appearance, combined with respiratory acidosis and hypoxemia, strongly suggests a surfactant deficiency.
